name: fix-pets-inventory-level
about: mods/pets: the active pet's level and XP progress sit beside the character's own level in the player menu's character tab (widget hwp-pet-level, a clone of player-level made by PetLevelTab.as; no Character.as override). The bot buys a pet, opens the character tab and reads the widget through `gl menu character - hwp-pet-level` (the tab is a MenuTab with its own widget tree, which `wtext` does not reach): `pet lvl N (xx%)`, shown; after `hwp pet xp 500` (pets.debug) the text shows the higher level.

steps.name: character tab shows the pet's level and keeps it current

steps.pattern: \[HWP:pets\] pet level line added to the character tab \(hwp-pet-level\)
